approval.note: Approved as launch service-level TARGETS: engineering targets that Zenith measures and works to meet, the same on every plan. They are not a contractual SLA and no service credits are offered. A contractual Enterprise SLA with service credits is a later, separate decision that follows production verification.

objectives.title: Control-plane availability (monthly)
objectives.sli: Control-plane requests that did not fail with a 5xx status, over all control-plane requests, measured two ways: from customer API requests (zenith_api_requests_total; 429 answers are the caller's own quota and count as served) and from an external probe that calls the control plane from outside (reported to the SLO measurements hook). When both report, the lower ratio is the figure. For customer-cloud (BYOC) deployments this covers Zenith's API and orchestration.

objectives.title: Managed runtime availability (monthly)
objectives.sli: Observations of workloads on Zenith-hosted (fully managed) deployments in supported production configurations in which all desired replicas were ready, over all such observations whose health was known (readiness read from the managed cluster on each reconcile pass). Customer-cloud (BYOC) workloads are outside this objective.

objectives.title: API latency (p95 under 500 ms)
objectives.sli: API requests answered within 500 ms, over all API requests (zenith_api_request_duration_seconds). A 95% target is the statement 'p95 is under 500 ms'.

objectives.title: Dispatch latency (95% within 30 s after approval)
objectives.sli: Eligible operations that started running within 30 s, over all eligible operations that started (platform.operations). The clock starts at the last required approval, or at creation when no approval is required; time spent waiting for a human is not counted.

objectives.title: Workflow completion
objectives.sli: Operations that finished as succeeded, over operations that finished as succeeded, failed or uncertain (platform.operations). Failures caused by a tenant's own configuration are included: the indicator does not yet separate them.

objectives.title: Scheduler health
objectives.sli: Critical periodic jobs that are healthy (recent success, not failing) at each sample, over all critical jobs sampled (platform.scheduled_job_runs, PROD-OBS-04). Durable-only jobs that have never run are not sampled.

objectives.title: Sustained capacity
objectives.sli: Requests per second the capacity test (scripts/slo/capacity-test.mjs) sustained with p95 under 500 ms and an error rate of at most 0.5%. Measured on the machine that ran the test, not on a production topology.

objectives.title: Recovery point objective
objectives.sli: Seconds between the last data recovered by a restore rehearsal and the moment of the simulated failure, for explicitly covered data.

objectives.title: Recovery time objective
objectives.sli: Seconds between the simulated failure and the moment a restore rehearsal reports the service answering again, for explicitly covered data. This disaster-recovery objective is not an allowance under the monthly availability targets.
